Domain / guidance: Protein: varied sources, including red meat; 1.2–1.6 g/kg/day
UK Biobank variable and rule: Total protein / weight; 10 points at ≥1.2 g/kg/day
Difference from guidance: Total protein does not distinguish sources. YGB has no upper-range penalty; quintiles are relative.
Broad dairy measures do not require full-fat products without added sugar.
Food mappings and quintiles do not directly measure the full recommendation.
Broad groups and relative ranks differ from absolute adherence.
YGB uses the lower bound; proxy classifications and quintiles are author choices.

Domain / guidance: Fats: whole-food sources; saturated fat ≤10% energy
CHNS variable and rule: Plant oil / (plant oil + animal fat + 0.1 g) proxy; Q+
Difference from guidance: No guideline-prescribed fat ratio or 1-serving target. CHNS fatty-acid coverage was insufficient.

Domain / guidance: Processing: limit highly processed/refined foods; avoid sugary drinks
UK Biobank variable and rule: Refined grains, sweets, sugary drinks, fried/fast foods; 10→0 points over 0–4 servings
NHANES variable and rule: Same broad groups plus red or processed meat; Q−
CHNS variable and rule: Refined grains, sweets, sugary drinks, processed meat, deep- fried/fast/convenience foods; Q−
Difference from guidance: Proxies are not NOVA. NHANES adversely counts unprocessed red meat; processed-only and meat- omitted sensitivities address this choice.
The numeric cutoff and relative ranks are author choices; food- derived intake may miss beverages.

UK Biobank variable and rule: Sodium mg/day; 10 at ≤2,300, declining to 0 at ≥5,000
Difference from guidance: The 5,000-mg zero point and quintiles are author choices; mapped intakes may miss discretionary salt.
